snippet.title: Spooky Dwellers 5
snippet.description:
What began as the perfect Halloween livestream at the historic Korvhat Castle quickly descends into a chilling nightmare. When the malevolent ancient entity Kthal-zghor awakens from its slumber, your friends vanish into the shadows, leaving you entirely alone to face a legion of spooky dwellers!

Armed with a powerful Talisman of Light, you must navigate the castle's haunted halls to banish the tragic ghosts of the Korvhat bloodline. Battle the creeping darkness through dozens of challenging Match 3 levels, wielding unique gameplay mechanics to outsmart the ancient evil and purify the cursed grounds.

Between intense puzzles, catch your breath by exploring Hidden Object scenes and solving other minigames to unlock your path forward. Gather your courage and collect trophies to earn coins, which you'll use to fully decorate The Party Parlor - the ultimate festive backdrop your group dreamed of setting up before the chaos began!

Can you vanquish the shadows, uncover the dark truth, and survive the mystery of Korvhat Castle?

Download the FREE trial for PC!

Available for Game Club Members on October 13th, 2026.
